formula: He/She/It + verb + S   |   Questions: Does + he/she/it + base verb   |   some (+) / any (− ?)
when_to_use: Add -s to the verb for he/she/it. Use 'some' in positive sentences and 'any' in negatives and questions.
when_to_use_ar: نضيف -s للفعل مع he/she/it. ونستخدم some في الإثبات و any في النفي والسؤال.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: The third-person -s has no Arabic equivalent and is the most commonly dropped ending at A1. Also, once 'does' is used, learners often keep the -s twice ('does she likes').

common_errors.explanation: After DOES the verb goes back to base form.
Use ANY in negatives and questions.

quick_rule: he/she/it → verb + S. After DOES/DOESN'T → base verb. SOME in (+), ANY in (−) and (?).
quick_rule_ar: he/she/it تأخذ الفعل + S. وبعد does/doesn't الفعل يرجع مجرد. some في الإثبات و any في النفي والسؤال.
mnemonic: He, She, It — don't forget the S!
connect_to_speaking: Describe a family member's routine: 'My brother works in a shop. He doesn't eat meat. Does he like tea? Yes, he drinks some every day.'
